newsitem.title: USA: Union Property to merge with Kranzco.
newsitem.headline: Union Property to merge with Kranzco.

text.p: Union Property Investors Inc said Tuesday that it has entered into a definitive agreement to merge with a wholly owned subsidiary of Kranzco Realty Trust, in a stock for stock transaction.
Union Property said that Kranzco will issue about 0.298 Series B convertible preferred shares in exchange for each outstanding share of Union Property common stock.

The company said that Kranzco's Series B convertible preferred shares will be convertible into 1.304, 1.338 and 1.374 shares of Kranzco's common shares during the second, third and fourth years respectively, following the consummation of the merger.
Thereafter the shares will be convertible into 1.411 shares of Kranzco's common shares, it said.
